definition: hair twisted into a round knot on the head
description: A young woman with glasses and her blonde hair twisted up into a round knot on top of her head stands reading a paperback in a moving tram, city buildings sliding past the windows. She then sits cross-legged on a park bench in autumn sunshine, the same knot of hair on top, reading and yawning behind her hand. In the last shots she is under a blanket in the dark with a single candle burning beside the open book, eyes wide behind her glasses, then grinning as she reads on.

en.question: How is the woman wearing her hair?
